title: The dual Artin isomorphism for Artin groups of XXL type
summary: We show that an Artin group $A_Γ$ of XXL type (with all defining integers satisfying $m_{ij}\geq 5$) is isomorphic to the corresponding dual Artin group for any choice of Coxeter element. Our proof involves the set of Hurwitz words $Q$ which arise from the Hurwitz action on tuples of elements of the free group. We show that the canonical epimorphism from $A_Γ$ to the dual Artin group is an isomorphism if and only if the projection from $A_Γ$ to the Coxeter group is injective on the image of $Q$.
